name: ContentVerificationResults
description: Provides the status of verifying whether the content of a document has changed.

constants.name: contverresError
constants.description: The verification resulted in an error.

constants.name: contverresVerifying
constants.description: The content of the document is currently being verified.

constants.name: contverresUnverified
constants.description: The document has not been verified.

constants.name: contverresValid
constants.description: The content of the document has been verified and is valid.

constants.name: contverresModified
constants.description: The content of the document has been modified since it was digitally signed.
